avis.texte: I have 2 bottles of the Biphase mist, one for skincare after makeup is off and one in the bathroom for makeup application! Dare I say I bought this one and the prequel facial mist, IMO this is the one! The mister itself is excellent, my aging skin loves what this Biphase formula does to it! Makes my skin feel very soft and glowy, and very hydrated. This spray also works really well w/my st. Tropez fake tan facial mist!

I love this product so much because it's refreshing, nourishing, and lightweight. I've repurchased it in the past, but this will be my last bottle, unfortuately. Wish I could repurchase in good consicence!

I use it after the pore serum dries i like how my face doesn't look dry or feel dry. I can tell when i dont use it my face looks bland no bouncy look if thats the right word lol i love it! I dont like using alot of products but i do love this one!

I'm so tired at night and don't like touching my face much, so i swear by spraying my face at night. used to use futurewise mist but.. naturium has been the best dupe so far. 0 face dryness after shower and mist. just way too expensive!
The spray nozzle was spraying fine but after a few sprits it became a solid stream that shoots out. I don't know how that happened but seems like a mechanical issue.
Within a couple of minutes after spraying this on my face, my face started stinging. Washed it off and it stopped stinging. Its not for me.

I love Naturium products, and this newest addition didn't disappoint. I prefer using a face mist in the mornings, and have been struggling to find one that I like. I decided to give this one a try and have been loving it so far. My face feels really soft after misting and I thankfully haven't had any reactions. My skin is easily sensitized so this was important for me!

I recently started using the Naturium Barrier Bounce Mist, and I have to say, I'm impressed. As someone with dry and sensitive skin, finding a product that hydrates and soothes without irritating is a game changer. This mist delivers just that – it provides an instant boost of hydration that feels lightweight yet deeply nourishing and fragrance-free. It's become a staple for when my skin feels tight or just a refresher without feeling any greasiness or residue. The only downside, for me, is the price. While it's a fantastic product, I do think it's on the pricier side for something you'd typically find at a drugstore. That said, the quality of the product makes it worth the splurge if you're looking for something that delivers real results for dry and sensitive skin.

It's the same Barrier Bounce I already love in a lightweight mist! And I obsess over a good mist. While this is lighter, it imparts the same moisture, comfort, and glow as the OG. It is a stellar product and now it has a sidekick! Just one note ~ this did arrive when the temp was below freezing. I, of course, had to test it out immediately. At first I was disappointed because I mistakenly thought the misting component was awful. Instead of a pleasant mist it was just spitting large droplets at me. I eventually realized that happened because the liquid was just too cold to mist.Tried again after it had some time to warm up to room temp, the mister is lovely and just what I'd hoped for.

I was really hesitant because of the price but my skin was RUINED from actives. Dry, rough, acne. it was painful. literally the first morning i woke up after using this, the red bumps that covered my jaw were gone. Its been four days consistent use and my skin feels so hydrated and it hasnt caused me any acne. The bottle also still feels really full even though I've been using a lot of product

My skin is pretty tolerable of a lot of things and rarely reacts to new products. But this one irritated my skin (and my nose). Im not sure whats in it that caused the irritation, but small red bumps started to appear shortly after using this product. After a few days, I removed it from my lineup and skin went back to normal.

Sometimes influencers say everything is good but genuinely this is as good as the internet says it is. The original serum was a bit too oily for my liking and mists are so much easier anyway. Glass skin in a bottle!
I love to finish my routine with a facial spray and this Bi-face mist is perfect to help me lock-in moisture.
I bought this product a few weeks ago and i love it! The only thing that sucks is the sprayer😭 Mine doesn't spray my whole face but sprays in two different directions.
Love! Love! Love! Barrier Bounce in a Mist. Life is good.
